# Mutants for `__filename` and `__dirname` (#redxes2)

The ruling (docs/rulings.md, Nov 6) owes three mutants: `__filename` bound to the working directory, the CommonJS declaration ignored, and a `.a` file under a CommonJS declaration binding. They are recorded here together. None has been run yet: each is to be run on the test box against the tests it names, and this record is to say what it saw.

The installed-layout harness is internal/oracle/installed_layout_test.go: TestInstalledLayoutReadsAreNodes runs tsc_reads.ts on Node, transpiled to CommonJS by TypeScript 6.0.3's transpileModule as `typescript/lib/_tsc.js`, and built natively under `lower.ModuleFormatCommonJS` as `typescript/lib/_tsc`, each from internal/oracle, outside lib, beside `lib.d.ts`, `lib.es2020.d.ts` and `ja/diagnosticMessages.generated.json`. It compares their output byte for byte and pins Node's lines. The two lowering mutants' tests are in internal/lower/library_node_commonjs_test.go.

| Mutant | Edit | Red |
|---|---|---|
| (1) `__filename` bound to the working directory | internal/oracle/installed_layout_test.go, `installedLayoutCwdMutant`: the program's `adamic_node_filename()` and `adamic_node_dirname()` replaced by functions answering `<cwd>/_tsc` and `<cwd>` (`adamic_host_cwd`), defined after the C's includes, so lowering and the runtime archive are unchanged. The edit is planted by the test itself | TestInstalledLayoutCwdMutantMovesTheReads holds that the mutant's directory, `lib.d.ts`, locale and `lib.es2020.d.ts` lines all differ from Node's (`directory oracle`, `lib.d.ts false`, `locale missing`, `lib.es2020.d.ts false` where Node prints `directory lib`, `lib.d.ts true`, the locale's JSON and `lib.es2020.d.ts true`), so TestInstalledLayoutReadsAreNodes's comparison goes red on those four. The case probe isn't held: on a case-sensitive file system it agrees |
| (2) The CommonJS declaration ignored | internal/lower/library_node_commonjs.go, `nodeCommonJSModuleValuesBound`: `l.moduleFormat == ModuleFormatCommonJS && ` removed | TestNodeCommonJSNamesItsReasons/filename and /dirname, and TestNodeCommonJSSiteCountsOnce/filename and /dirname: the `.ts` reads under Lower's default lower, or count no site. TestNodeCommonJSModuleValuesBindInATSFileUnderCommonJS, both rows: declared an ES module, the read lowers |
| (3) A `.a` file under a CommonJS declaration binding | internal/lower/library_node_commonjs.go, `nodeCommonJSModuleValuesBound`: the suffix `".ts"` in its `strings.HasSuffix` check replaced by `""`, so every file passes it (removing the check outright leaves `strings` unused, and a mutant that doesn't compile catches nothing) | TestNodeCommonJSModuleValuesStayNotYetInAnAFile, both rows: testdata/commonjs_reasons/filename.a and dirname.a lower |

The ruling's harness rows not built here: `--listFiles`, which mutant (1) would also turn red, and `--generateCpuProfile`'s relativized URLs or its named stop. Each needs tsc's own reads of them, beyond tsc_reads.ts.
